request.text: Explain what HTTP 402 Payment Required actually standardizes, and whether it defines an interoperable payment protocol. Distinguish the specification from claims made by payment vendors. Use the original HTTP specification: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.txt

What does Celo say its architecture and fee-currency design offer developers? Verify the Ethereum L2 claim from official documentation, separate project assertions from independently demonstrated adoption or reliability, and state what these sources cannot establish. Sources: https://docs.celo.org/what-is-celo https://docs.celo.org/what-is-celo/using-celo/protocol/transaction/erc20-transaction-fees
